```{r}
ak04_1 = ak04 %>% mutate(Lon.W. = Lon.W.*-1) %>% rename(lat = Lat.N., lon = Lon.W.)
```


# Data for Battelle

```{r}
( cce_access = cce %>% 
  dplyr::select(fire_scar, site, year, latitude_at_0m, longitude_at_0m) %>%
  group_by(fire_scar, site) %>%
  summarise(year = paste(unique(year), collapse = ", "),
            latitude_at_0m = paste(unique(latitude_at_0m), collapse = ", "),
            longitude_at_0m = paste(unique(longitude_at_0m), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(latitude = str_extract(latitude_at_0m, "^[^,]+"),
         longitude = str_extract(longitude_at_0m, "^[^,]+")) %>%
  mutate(access = ifelse(fire_scar %in% c("Aggie Creek", "Hess Creek", "Isom", "Munson Creek", "Nugget Creek"), "Truck", 
                         ifelse(fire_scar %in% c("Lost Horse", "Haystack"), "Truck & ATVs", "Helocopter"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(latitude_at_0m, longitude_at_0m, year)) %>%
  mutate(latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
         longitude = as.numeric(longitude))
)
```

```{r}
( ak04_access = ak04_1 %>%
  dplyr::select(burn, site, lat, lon) %>%
  rename(latitude = lat, longitude = lon, fire_scar = burn) %>%
    mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  mutate(access = "truck") )
```
```{r}
( access = bind_rows(cce_access, ak04_access) )
```

```{r}
write_csv(access, "../outputs/2026-06-05_Battelle_SiteAccess.csv")
```

## Function to make points

```{r}
df_to_sf <- function(x){
  st_as_sf(x, coords = c("longitude_at_0m","latitude_at_0m"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
df_to_sf <- function(x){
  st_as_sf(x, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}
```

## Drop Lat Lon NA and convert to shapefile 

```{r}
( cce_pts = cce %>% 
    df_to_sf() )
```

```{r}
( ak04_pts = ak04_1 %>% 
    df_to_sf() )
```

# plot

```{r}
#my_colors <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8") 

mapview(cce_pts, col.regions = "#E41A1C")
```


# Write to shapefile

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
st_write(cce_pts, "../outputs/shapefile/2026-06-04_CCE_Points.shp", driver="ESRI Shapefile")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
st_write(ak04_pts, "../outputs/shapefile/2026-06-04_AK_JFSP_Points.shp", driver="ESRI Shapefile")
```
